text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the academy,
I saw Tanino Gimlet and Mejiro Ramonu talking
as they looked at something. It was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Surrounded by scrap materials that have suffered some kind of chaotic destruction, a single orange sits all alone... What a surreal space.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ohh!
To think my very first viewer would be you... Is this destiny, too?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Then let me ask you straight out!
What do you see in this piece?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"There's a theme you can feel
with your soul, isn't there?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Told that, I took another look, pondering it carefully this time... but I still didn't have a clue.
No matter how I looked at it, it was just an orange and some scrap wood.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As expected,
this is still incomplete.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I thought leaving the interpretation to others
was your style, though.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
No, my enchanting friend.
Regarding this piece, it's a no.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
This is our joint piece, after all!
I want its meaning to be etched deeply... into our souls...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"The femme fatale placed an orange,
and around it, I lined up scrap wood..."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
And this is the finished product.
I call it: 'The Serpent Guarding the Golden Apple'—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"This serpent would never tempt Eve.
It is a noble being that protects the apple and became a constellation."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
By the way, "golden apple" refers to an orange in many languages.
In other words—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: The moment she placed that orange there, I knew what had to be done... All inspiration begins with gravity!
choice_data_list: Why'd Ramonu leave an orange there?
Why did Ramonu leave an orange there?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
I just picked up what had fallen
and put it back again.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Touched by bewitching fingertips, the ordinary orange
has transformed into the golden apple planted in the garden of the gods...!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, time for the finishing touches.
Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
As a mere spectator, I shall grant you a choice.
Will it be further destruction, or perhaps reconstruction...!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to this piece, it ties into the classics...
A shared understanding is essential. You possess that perspective.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: You wouldn't mind, would you, my charming lady?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The method to convey the intention of the work.
Betting on a miracle born of destruction, or making the theme
easier to understand... The choice is—
choice_data_list: Reconstruct it to be easier to understand.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Correct!
Huh...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without missing a beat after the answer, Tanino Gimlet unleashed a ferocious kick...!
And then—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah... This is it, this is truly it...!
The snake is ascending to the stars...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Vigorously smashed to pieces, powder from the debris drifted through the air...
The sparkles looked—or at least, could almost be seen as—
constellations twinkling in the night sky... A subtle change had occurred.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
A recreation of mythology...!
Ramonu, it's complete! Our masterpiece!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Giggle...
What a lovely person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (KABOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without missing a beat after the answer, Tanino Gimlet unleashed a ferocious kick...!
As a result—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: ...How wretched.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as Ramonu said, everything except the orange was
destroyed... The chaos accelerated further, to the point
where it could no longer even be called a piece of art.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll give the orange to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...
I shall repay your kindness with an Orange Fizz mocktail.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose it's come to that.
It has already taken form, but... it cannot be helped.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Why not make it into a sculpture?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
You say that I can achieve it...
I take it that is praise? Then, I shall take on the challenge.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet began carving the scrap wood.
As Mejiro Ramonu and I watched her work away without a single hesitation—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... Such delicate scales.
Is that who you truly are?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"...If it were up to me,
would this glory be dedicated to my enchanting master?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
"You are free to dedicate it.
And free to handle it however you wish."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuhaha! Then by all means, be my guest...
"The serpent guarding the golden apple"
shall protect thee this time around—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: In that case, does the arrangement represent a snake...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, Tanino Gimlet rearranged the scrap wood and began shaping it into a snake... or so it seemed.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: ...How boring.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Until just now, the piece retained its mystique.
But look at it now. It is utterly farcical.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Still, there's no turning back.
The restructuring failed... I'll leave it as a reminder.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Of course, Tanino Gimlet and I
cleaned up properly afterwards.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If it's truly a piece of art, an amateur like me naturally hesitates to touch it up...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That, too, is a choice.
Whether to stay put is in one's own legs; being incomplete is also a form of completion...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: I'll leave the rest to you.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
...Even if the fair maiden is far away, the work remains.
Like a lingering, fragrant scent.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Beside Tanino Gimlet, who silently gazed at
the artwork after that, we spent the early afternoon
feeling the wind together for a while..."
